name: Short-Stay Visa / Visa-Free Entry (Schengen)

requirements.blocker_text: Iceland is a Schengen member (though not an EU member) and applies the standard 90 days within any 180-day period, whether entering visa-free or on a Schengen (Type C) visa.
Nationals of countries not covered by EU Regulation 2018/1806's visa-exemption list must obtain a Schengen short-stay visa before travel; others may enter visa-free for the same 90/180-day allowance.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Schengen visa at an Icelandic embassy/consulate (or a Nordic embassy representing Iceland) if not visa-exempt.

sources.title: Island.is (Icelandic government portal) -- Directorate of Immigration: overview of Iceland's Schengen short-stay framework and residence permit system

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Iceland). Iceland is an EEA/EFTA member and a Schengen member but NOT an EU member -- the visitor route follows the standard Schengen 90/180-day rule. Visa requirement is nationality-dependent per EU Regulation 2018/1806, modeled as a soft (hard:false) branch.
